AddImage.title: Add Image Data
AddImage.summary: This topic describes the syntax and sample of the AddImage operation for adding image data.
AddImage.description:
## Feature Description  
The AddImage feature allows you to add image data to a specified database.

> - You can add up to 50,000 images to each database.  
- If you need to connect to Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API, use the API, or have questions about the service, join the DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Service Notice  
The visual search service stopped updates on February 15, 2023. New users are no longer supported to activate or access this service. New users should use the [new Image Search service](https://ai.aliyun.com/imagesearch). After February 15, 2023, existing users will continue to be supported. If you have questions about using the visual search service, join the DingTalk group (23109592) by searching for the group number to contact us.

## Input Limits  
- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG.  
- Image size: No larger than 2 MB.  
- Image resolution: Greater than 128 × 128 pixels and less than 1024 × 1024 pixels.  
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.
AddImage.responseParamsDescription:
## SDK Reference  
We recommend that you use a software development kit (SDK) to call Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API. The SDK supports multiple programming languages. When you use an SDK, file parameters can be local files or URLs. For more information, see [Overview of SDKs](~~145033~~).
AddImage.extraInfo:
## Error Codes  
For error codes related to adding image data, see [Common Error Codes](~~159136~~).

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debugging expire after 1 hour and are automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.

ImageUrl.description:
The search result, which is the URL of a similar image.

> - We recommend that you use **EntryId** to determine the result. The **ImageURL** returned here is only the string you provided when creating the image gallery. The platform server-side does not retain the original images from your image gallery. If you used a time-limited access link when uploading the image gallery, you must retain the image locally and maintain the mapping between **EntryID** and the image.
- This URL is temporary and has a validity period of 30 minutes. It will no longer be accessible after expiration.

Score.description: The similarity score, ranging from 0 to 10. A higher score indicates greater similarity.
